καταλαμβάνω.s: καταλαμβάνω, (A) act. (a) I seize tight hold of, arrest, catch, capture, appropriate, Mk. ix 18, [John] viii 3, 4, Rom. ix 30, 1 Cor. ix 24, Phil. iii 12, 13; (b) I overtake, John i 5, vi 17 (v.l.), xii 35, 1 Thess. v 4; (B) mid. aor. I perceived, comprehended.

κλάω.d: iconoclast, literally, a breaker of images

κληρονόμος.s: κληρονόμος, an heir, an inheritor: cf. κληρονομία.

κτίζω.s: κτίζω, I create, found, make, always of God.

μοιχεύω.s: μοιχεύω, I commit adultery (of a man with a married woman, but also (Lk. xvi 18) of a married man).

νομίζω.mg: to be accustomed to, be wont, consider, think, believe that

ξηραίνω.d: cf. xerophagy, among early Christians, the practice of living on a diet of dry food, especially during Lent and other fasts

ὅθεν.s: ὅθεν (unde), (a) local, whence, from which place; (b) inferential, wherefore.

οἰκουμένη.s: οἰκουμένη (properly present pcpl. pass. of οἰκέω, with γῆ understood, the land that is being inhabited, the land in a state of habitation), the inhabited world, that is, the Roman world (orbis terrarum), for all outside it was regarded as of no account.

ὁμοιόω.d: homoeoteleuton, the occurrence of the same or similar endings of lines, a frequent source of error in copied manuscripts
ὁμοιόω.s: ὁμοιόω, I make like, liken; I compare.

οὐδέποτε.s: οὐδέποτε, not at any time, never.

παρθένος.s: παρθένος, a maiden, a virgin; hence (Rev. xiv 4), extended to men who have not known women: in 1 Cor. vii 25–38, the word must have its usual sense, and refer to women living in merely spiritual wedlock with men. In Mt. i 23 παρθένος is an inaccurate translation (due to LXX) of a Heb. word in Isa. vii 14 meaning a female adolescent, a young woman of marriageable age, whether married or not, rightly translated by Theodotion and Aquila νεᾶνις.

παύομαι.mg: to cause to cease, stop; pass. and mid., cease
παύομαι.s: παύω, (a) act. I cause to cease, 1 Pet. iii 10; (b) mid. I cease.

ποτίζω.s: ποτίζω (poto, potiono), I cause to drink, I make to drink, I give drink to.

σαλεύω.s: σαλεύω, I shake, lit. and met.; I dislodge.

σκάνδαλον.s: σκάνδαλον (offendiculum) (a Hebraistic, biblical word), stumbling, cause of stumbling (in the moral sphere); πέτρα σκανδάλου (Isa. viii 14), the native rock rising up through the earth, which trips up the traveller, hence, of Jesus the Messiah, to the Jews who refused him: some person (Mt. xiii 41, xvi 23) or thing which leads one to sin.

συμφέρω.g: I bring together; impersonally, it is profitable
συμφέρω.s: συμφέρω, (a) tr. I collect, bring together, Ac. xix. 19; (b) intr. and generally impersonal, συμφέρει, it is an advantage, it is expedient (beneficial); συμφέρον (sc. ἐστιν), 2 Cor. xii 1 = συμφέρει; τὸ συμφέρον, as substantive.

σφραγίζω.d: cf. sphragistics, the science of seals, their history, age, distinctions, etc.
σφραγίζω.s: σφραγίζω, (a) I seal and thus close, for guardianship or protection, Mt. xxvii 66, Rev. xx 3; (b) I conceal, Rev. x 4, xxii 10; (c) I mark with the impress of the signet ring, lit. or met.; (d) I confirm, make undoubted, John iii 33, vi 27; mid. Rom. xv 28 (cf. under (a)).

τράπεζα.d: trapeze, so called from the square or rectangle formed by the ropes and crossbar

τύπος.s: τύπος (originally, the mark of a blow, cf. John xx 25: then a stamp struck by a die), (a) a figure; a copy, image; (b) a pattern, model; (c) a type, prefiguring something or somebody.

χόρτος.s: χόρτος, grass, hay, such grass or herbage as makes fodder.

ὠφελέω.s: ὠφελέω, I help, benefit, do good, am useful (to): absol. Rom. ii 25; with adv. acc. οὐδέν, in no way, τί, in what way?; generally c. acc. of the person.

ἀλλότριος.s: ἀλλότριος (alienus), belonging to another person, belonging to others.

ἀμφότεροι.s: ἀμφότεροι, both (of two): in Ac. xix 16, xxiii 8, perhaps = all (of more than two); so in common speech and in Byzantine Greek.

ἀνάκειμαι.s: ἀνάκειμαι, I recline (especially at a dinner-table).

ἀναχωρέω.s: ἀναχωρέω, (a) I return, Mt. ii 12; (b) I retire, depart (underlying idea perhaps of taking refuge from danger or of going into retirement).

ἀνθίστημι.s: ἀνθίστημι, only in intransitive tenses of active, and in all tenses of the middle or passive, I take a stand against, oppose, resist.

ἀνομία.s: ἀνομία, lawlessness; especially disobedience to the divine law, sin.

ἀπειθέω.s: ἀπειθέω, I disobey, I rebel, I am disloyal.

ἀτενίζω.g: I look intently, gaze upon intently
ἀτενίζω.s: ἀτενίζω, I direct my gaze, I look steadily.

ἀφίστημι.s: ἀφίστημι (a) 1 aor. tr. I made to stand away, I drew away, Ac. v 37; I repelled; (b) other tenses of act., and mid. I take up a position away from, I withdraw from, I leave.

γράμμα.g: a letter (of the alphabet); plural, writings
γράμμα.s: γράμμα (littera), a letter of the alphabet; collectively, written (revelation), Rom. ii 27: γράμματα (litterae), writings, (a) a written document, Lk. xvi 6, 7; a letter, an epistle, Ac. xxviii 21; (b) writings, literature, John v 47, vii 15, Ac. xxvi 24, 2 Tim. iii 15.

διαλογισμός.s: διαλογισμός, a calculation, reasoning, thought, movement of thought, deliberation, plotting.

ἐλάχιστος.s: ἐλάχιστος, least, smallest (Mt., 1 Cor. xv 9), but perhaps oftener in the weaker sense, very little, very small (Lk., 1 Cor. iv 3, vi 2, James): ὁ ἐλαχιστότερος, the smallest, the least important: εἰς ἐλάχιστόν ἐστιν, it matters very little: ἐλάχιστον, adv. a very little.

ἐπίσταμαι.d: cf. epistemology, the science of the methods and grounds of knowledge
ἐπίσταμαι.mg: to know, understand, believe. ☞ Do not confuse with forms of ἐφ-ίστημι

εὐφραίνω.d: cf. Euphrosyne, one of the three Graces in Greek mythology
εὐφραίνω.s: εὐφραίνω, I cheer, make glad: generally mid. or pass. I am glad; I make merry, revel, feast.

κατανοέω.s: κατανοέω, I understand, take in a fact about, take knowledge of, take notice of, perceive; I detect, Lk. xx 23; I master, Ac. vii 31.

κληρονομία.s: κληρονομία, an inheritance, an heritage, regularly the gift of God to His chosen people, in O. T. the Promised Land, in N. T. a possession viewed in one sense as present, in another as future.

κοινός.s: κοινός, (a) common, shared; (b) Hebraistic use (in contrast to ἅγιος), profane; dirty, unclean, unwashed, Mk. vii 2, Ac. x 14, 28, xi 8, Rom. xiv 14, Heb. x 29, Rev. xxi 27.

κοινόω.d: cf. cenobite, one dwelling in a convent community [where all is held in common]
κοινόω.s: κοινόω (cf. κοινός), (a) I make unclean, I pollute; (b) mid. I regard (treat) as unclean, Ac. x 15, xi 9.

μακρόθεν.s: μακρόθεν, from a (long) distance, often in the tautological expression ἀπὸ μακρόθεν = μακρόθεν, ἀπὸ μακράν (cf. Lk. xviii 13).

μερίζω.s: μερίζω, I divide into parts, I divide, I part, I share, I distribute; mid. I go shares, I share (with others; in this case with Paul, Apollos, Cephas), I take part in a partitioning, 1 Cor. i 13; I distract, 1 Cor. vii 34.

μέτρον.s: μέτρον, a measure, whether lineal (e.g. Rev. xxi 15) or cubic (e.g. Lk. vi 38): ἐκ μέτρου (Aramaic idiom?), in scanty measure.

μωρός.s: μωρός, (a) adj. foolish; (b) noun a fool.

νοέω.s: νοέω, I understand, conceive, apprehend; aor. possibly realize, John xii 40, Eph. iii 4.

ξένος.g: strange; as a noun, a stranger, host
ξένος.s: ξένος, (a) adj. foreign, Ac. xvii 18; strange, unusual, Heb. xiii 9, 1 Pet. iv 12; (b) noun (hospes) a stranger, a foreigner (either one belonging to another community in the same country, or to another country); a resident alien, without city rights, Ac. xvii 21, Eph. ii 19, Heb. xi 13; c. gen. a stranger to, Eph. ii 12; a host (guest) friend, the word indicating the reciprocal relationship, which was a sacred one, Rom. xvi 23.

οἷος.mg: what, what kind of, (such) as; οἷός τέ εἰμι, I am the man to, I am able to; ὡς οἷόν τε μάλιστα, as much as possible
οἷος.s: οἷος (qualis), properly correlative to τοιοῦτος, the combined expression meaning of such a kind as, 1 Cor. xv 48; by itself, both rel. and indirect interrog., such as, of what kind (character): οὐχ οἷον δὲ ὅτι, Rom. ix 6, is equivalent to a strong negative, not of course (lit. it is not so that).

ὄφις.d: Ophites, Gnostics who revered the serpent as the symbol of hidden, divine wisdom

ὀψία.s: ὀψία, of a period never earlier than sunset; early evening.

πετεινά.s: πετεινός, flying: neut. πετεινόν, a bird.

προσδέχομαι.s: προσδέχομαι, (a) I await, expect; (b) I receive, welcome (originally to my house), e.g. Lk. xv 2, Rom. xvi 2, Phil. ii 29; (c) I accept, Ac. xxiv 15.

σῖτος.d: parasite, literally, one who sits by [παρά] another's food and eats at his expense

στηρίζω.s: στηρίζω, (a) I fix firmly, Lk. xvi 26; τὸ πρόσωπον (Hebraism) I direct myself towards, I have my face turned stedfastly, Lk. ix 51; (b) generally met. I buttress, prop, support; I strengthen, establish.

τάλαντον.s: τάλαντον, a talent, that is a talent-weight (see ταλαντιαῖος) of silver, both the weight and the value being different in different countries and at different times. A common value was 6000 denarii, that is somewhat between £175 and £235, but with much greater purchasing power.

ταπεινόω.s: ταπεινόω, lit. I make low, I lower, Lk. iii 5: generally met. I humble.

χωλός.s: χωλός, lame: generalizing neut., Heb. xii 13.

ἀθετέω.d: athetize, to reject a text or passage as spurious
ἀθετέω.s: ἀθετέω, I annul, make of no effect, set aside, ignore, slight; I break faith with, Mk. vi 26.

ἀνά.g: with the acc., upwards, up; with numerals, each; ἀνὰ μέσον, into the midst, among
ἀνά.mg: prep. mostly w. accus., up, during, up to
ἀνά.s: ἀνά, prep. up; hence up along; ἀνὰ μέσον, in the middle: most commonly with a distributive force, e.g. ἀνὰ δηνάριον (Mt. xx 9), ‘a denarius each’, ἀνὰ δύο χιτῶνας (Lk. ix 3), ‘two tunics each’, ἀνὰ πεντήκοντα (Lk. ix 14), ‘in fifties’, ‘in groups of fifty’, ἀνὰ δύο (Lk. x 1), ‘two by two’ (where perhaps ἀνὰ δύο δύο, a mixed distributive, ought to be read).

ἀναλαμβάνω.mg: to take up, or with, pick up, assume
ἀναλαμβάνω.s: ἀναλαμβάνω, (a) I take up, raise; (b) I pick up, 2 Tim. iv 11, or take on board, Ac. xx 13, 14; (c) I carry off, lead away, Ac. xxiii 31.

ἀναστροφή.s: ἀναστροφή (conuersatio) (not in papyri, common in inscriptions), dealing with other men, going up and down among men, life, manner of life.

ἄνωθεν.s: ἄνωθεν, (a) from above, sometimes strengthened by ἀπό, from heaven (locally and spiritually); (b) from the beginning, from their origin (source), from of old, Lk. i 3, Ac. xxvi 5, Gal. iv 9, James i 17; (c) again (the meaning taken out of Jesus' words by Nicodemus, John iii 4, where δεύτερον is his paraphrase of ἄνωθεν (iii 3)).

ἁρπάζω.s: ἁρπάζω, I seize, snatch, obtain by robbery.

δαιμονίζομαι.s: δαιμονίζομαι, I am under the power of an evil-spirit or demon.

διαλέγομαι.s: διαλέγομαι, I converse, Mk. ix 34; elsewhere, I address, preach, lecture.

διαφέρω.s: διαφέρω, (a) tr. I carry through, hither and thither; (b) intr. I am different, I differ, sometimes c. gen.: hence c. gen. I surpass, I excel.

εἶτα.s: εἶτα, then, thereafter, next (marking a fresh stage).

ἐλεημοσύνη.s: ἐλεημοσύνη, abstr. alms-giving, charity: concr. alms, charity.

ἕξ.d: Hexapla, the edition of the Old Testament compiled by Origen, in the 3rd century, comprising six columns
ἕξ.mg: form ἐκ takes before a vowel

ἐξαποστέλλω.s: ἐξαποστέλλω, I send away out, I send forth (a person qualified for a task).

ἔξωθεν.s: ἔξωθεν, (a) from outside, from without; (b) outside, equivalent to ἔξω, both as adv. and as prep. (Mk. vii 15, Rev. xi 2, xiv 20, &c.); τὸ ἔξωθεν, the outside, &c., οἱ ἔξωθεν = οἱ ἔξω.

ἐπιζητέω.s: ἐπιζητέω, I seek after, search for, make inquiries about.

ἐπιπίπτω.s: ἐπιπίπτω, I fall upon; I press upon, Mk. iii 10.

ζύμη.s: ζύμη, leaven, ferment, both lit. and met.

θύω.s: θύω, I sacrifice, generally an animal; hence I kill.

καταισχύνω.s: καταισχύνω, I shame, disgrace, bring to shame, put to utter confusion.

καταντάω.s: καταντάω, (a) I come down, either from high land to lower (or actually to the sea-coast), or from the high seas to the coast; hence met. I reach (my destination), Ac. xxvi 7, Eph. iv 13, Phil. iii 11; (b) of property, I come down (descend) by inheritance to an heir, 1 Cor. x 11, xiv 36.

καταρτίζω.s: καταρτίζω, (a) I fit (join) together, Mk. i 19, Mt iv 21; met. I compact together, 1 Cor. i 10; (b) act. and mid. I prepare, I perfect, for his (its) full destination or use, I bring into its proper condition (whether for the first time, or after a lapse).

κλέπτω.s: κλέπτω, I steal; ὁ κλέπτων, the stealer, Eph. iv 28.

παιδεύω.s: παιδεύω, (a) I discipline, educate, train; (b) more severely, I chastise.

παιδίσκη.s: παιδίσκη, a female slave, a maidservant, a maid.

παράδοσις.s: παράδοσις, originally abstract, handing over, generally concrete, that which is handed down, a tradition (whether of written or of oral teaching).

πρίν.s: πρίν, used either with or without ἤ (than) and with the infin. following (once with ἄν and subjunctive, Lk. ii 26, once with the optative, Ac. xxv 16), before.

πώς.g: at all, somehow, in any way
πώς.s: πως, indefinite, enclitic, in some way, in any way: εἴ πως, if in any way; see μήπως.

συνεργός.d: cf. synergism, the Semi-Pelagian doctrine that there are two efficient agents in regeneration, namely the human will and the divine Spirit, which, in the strict sense of the term, co-operate

τίμιος.s: τίμιος, precious, valuable, in the literal sense (of money value), e.g. Rev. xvii 4, and also, e.g. Ac. v 34, in an extended sense.

τρόπος.d: in rhetoric, trope, a figurative use of a word
τρόπος.s: τρόπος, manner, way: often acc. as adv. ὃν τρόπον, in the way in which, as, also with κατά, &c.; manner of life, Heb. xiii 5.

ὕψιστος.s: ὕψιστος, highest, always as epithet either of God, or of the region where He lives.

φύσις.s: φύσις, nature, inherent nature, in N.T. non-moral, neither good nor bad; φύσει, by nature, in myself (itself, &c.).

χρυσίον.s: χρυσίον, gold: plur. gold (golden) ornaments, 1 Pet. iii 3.

ἀλέκτωρ.d: cf. alectryomancy, divination by means of a cock encircled by grains of corn placed on letters of the alphabet, the letters being then put together in the order in which the grains were eaten

ἀναπαύω.g: I refresh; middle, I take rest
ἀναπαύω.mg: to make to cease; mid. cease
ἀναπαύω.s: ἀναπαύω, (a) act. I make to rest, I give rest to; (b) mid. and pass. I rest, take my ease (see ἀνάπαυσις).

ἀναπίπτω.s: ἀναπίπτω, I lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), I fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).

ἀπαρνέομαι.s: ἀπαρνέομαι, I deny, disown, repudiate (either another person or myself).

ἀσκός.d: in botany, ascidium, the leaf of the pitcher plant

αὐλή.d: in Austro-German history, the Aulic Council
αὐλή.s: αὐλή, court-yard, fore-court; but it may be understood as palace, house, e.g. Mt. xxvi 3.

βαπτιστής.s: βαπτιστής, the baptizer, the baptist, epithet used only of John, the son of Zechariah and Elizabeth, forerunner of Jesus.

βῆμα.d: in ecclesiastical architecture, bema, the inner part of the chancel, reserved for the clergy
βῆμα.s: βῆμα (from root of ἔβην, I went), (a) βῆμα ποδός, the space covered by a step of the foot; (b) tribunal.

γέεννα.s: γέεννα (Aram.), gehenna, and originally gē ben hinnōm name of a valley or cavity near Jerusalem, Jer. vii 31, 2 Kings xxiii 10, a place underneath the earth, a place of punishment (retributive or purificatory) for evil.

δεῦτε.s: δεῦτε (plur. of δεῦρο), come hither, come, hither, an exclamatory word.

διάνοια.s: διάνοια (process of reasoning in Plato), understanding, intellect, mind.

ἐξάγω.s: ἐξάγω, I lead out, sometimes to death, execution (duco).

ἐξουθενέω.s: ἐξουθενέω, I set at nought, ignore, despise.

ἔσωθεν.s: ἔσωθεν, (a) from within, from inside; (b) within, inside: τὸ ἔσωθεν, the inner part, the inner element.

καίω.s: καίω, tr. I ignite, I light, I burn, lit. and met.

κάλαμος.s: κάλαμος, a reed; a reed-pen, 3 John 13.

κολλάομαι.s: κολλάω (lit. I glue): hence, mid. and pass. I join myself closely, I cleave, I adhere (to), I keep company (with), of friendly intercourse; of inanimate objects, Lk. x 11.

κομίζω.mg: to provide for, get, carry, bring
κομίζω.s: κομίζω, (a) act. I convey, bring, Lk. vii 37; (b) mid. I receive back, I receive what has belonged to myself but has been lost, or else promised but kept back, or I get what has come to be my own by earning, I recover.

κράτος.d: cf. democracy, rule of the people
κράτος.s: κράτος, Divine might, rule, power, except in Heb. ii 14.

λιμός.d: in medicine, limosis, excessive and morbid hunger

μάλιστα.mg: most, especially; w. numerals, full, as 131
μάλιστα.s: μάλιστα (superlative, see μᾶλλον), most of all, especially.

οἰκοδεσπότης.s: οἰκοδεσπότης, a master of a house, a head of a house (possibly a play upon words with Βεεζεβούλ).

ὅραμα.s: ὅραμα (literally, something seen), a sight, a vision.

παραιτέομαι.s: παραιτέομαι, (a) I beg from another, Mk. xv 6 (v. l.), Heb. xii 19 (cf. (b)); (b) (deprecor), I beg off from, I seek to turn away (from myself) by entreaty; hence, I give an excuse, I excuse myself, I beg to be excused, Lk. xiv 18, 19, Heb. xii 25; I decline, refuse, object to, Ac. xxv 11, 1 Tim. iv 7, v 11, 2 Tim. ii 23, Tit. iii 10.

πιάζω.s: πιάζω (a Doric form; contrast πιέζω), I take hold of, seize, apprehend, catch, arrest, grasp.

πλουτέω.s: πλουτέω, I am rich (wealthy): with εἰς and acc. the person on whom the wealth is lavished is indicated: with ἐν, I abound in, 1 Tim. vi 18.

πρόθεσις.d: in the Eastern Church, the prothesis, referring to the placing of the eucharistic elements
πρόθεσις.s: πρόθεσις, (a) οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς προθέσεως (Hebraistic), lit. the loaves of the laying out (before God), i.e. the loaves laid out, grecized in Heb. ix 2, ἡ πρόθεσις τῶν ἄρτων: (b) deliberate purpose (plan, scheme).

προσλαμβάνω.s: προσλαμβάνομαι, (a) I take to myself; (b) I take aside, Mk. viii 32, Mt. xvi 22, Ac. xvii 5, xviii 26; (c) I welcome, Ac. xxviii 2, Rom. xiv 1, &c.

πρωΐ.s: πρωΐ, early, in the morning (in John xx 1, even of the period before dawn).

πῶλος.s: πῶλος, (the young of various animals, hence, particularly) the foal (colt) of an ass.

σαλπίζω.s: σαλπίζω, I sound the bugle, I give a blast of the bugle: the subject is sometimes omitted, so that the word becomes practically impersonal.

σπλαγχνίζομαι.s: σπλαγχνίζομαι (Hebraism), I am filled with tenderness.

σπουδή.s: σπουδή (characteristically in connexion with religion), haste; eagerness, zeal; carefulness, care, anxiety; diligence, earnestness.

στήκω.s: στήκω (form arising from the need for an active form present in the intransitive sense, cf. ἵστημι) I stand; I remain standing, stand firm, lit. or met.

συνέχω.s: συνέχω, (a) I hold together, hence I restrain; I close, Ac. vii 57; I press from every side, Lk. viii 45, xix 43; (b) I hold seized, I have in charge, Lk. xxii 63, so pass. met. I am pressed, Ac. xviii 5: esp. in pass. with datives, I am seized (by), I am afflicted (by), I am suffering (from), e.g. Mt. iv 24, Lk. viii 37: I urge, impel, compel, Lk. xii 50, 2 Cor. v 14, Phil. i 23.

ταχύ.d: tachygraphy, stenography, especially that of the ancient Greeks and Romans
ταχύ.s: ταχύ (neut. of ταχύς as adv.), quickly, speedily.

τυγχάνω.mg: to hit, meet with, obtain, happen
τυγχάνω.s: τυγχάνω, (a) c. gen. I obtain; (b) absol. I chance, happen: τυχών, ordinary, everyday, Ac. xix 11, xxviii 2; εἰ τύχοι (lit. if it should happen), it may chance; old acc. absolute, belonging to impersonal verbs, τυχόν, perhaps.

ὑγιαίνω.s: ὑγιαίνω, I am in (good) health, I am healthy (well): hence met. in connexion with words and teaching, I am right, reasonable.

ὑγιής.s: ὑγιής, whole, in health, sound; restored to health: met. reasonable.

ὑψηλός.s: ὑψηλός, (a) lit. high, lofty; (b) met. μετὰ βραχίονος ὑψηλοῦ (Hebraistic), of God; with φρονεῖν, of haughtiness, arrogance, boasting.

φιάλη.s: φιάλη (poculum), strictly a wine-cup, much like a modern champagne-glass in shape; hence a cup.

φονεύω.s: φονεύω, c. acc. I murder; absol. I commit murder.

χωρίζω.s: χωρίζω, (a) act. tr. I separate, I put apart; (b) mid. or pass. I separate myself, I depart.

ψεύδομαι.s: ψεύδομαι, I speak falsely: c. acc. I deceive by words, Ac. v 3.

ἀγαλλιάω.s: ἀγαλλιάω, I exult, I am full of joy.

ἀναστρέφω.mg: to turn upside down, subvert, return, retire
ἀναστρέφω.s: ἀναστρέφω, (a) I overturn, turn upside down, John ii 15 (text doubtful); (b) I return, Ac. v 22, xv 16 (in a Hebraistic idiom, where the verb means little more than the adverb again); (c) mid. and pass. (conuersari) I conduct (behave) myself, live (with reference to the manner of life, especially in a moral and religious aspect), Mt. xvii 22 (text doubtful), &c., often with ἐν and a noun indicating condition or circumstances.

ἀρχαῖος.s: ἀρχαῖος, original, primitive; ancient, Mt. v 21, &c.

βρῶσις.s: βρῶσις, (a) (abstr.) eating; (b) food; a meal, Heb. xii 16; (c) rust.

διαμερίζω.s: διαμερίζω, I divide up into parts, break up; I distribute.

δωρεά.s: δωρεά, a (free) gift, a gift (without repayment).

εἴδωλον.s: εἴδωλον (simulacrum), an image of a god.

εἴκοσι.d: icosahedron, a geometric figure with twenty faces

εἰσάγω.s: εἰσάγω, I lead in, bring in.

ἐκχύννομαι.s: ἐκχέω, I pour out (liquid or solid), I shed. See ἐκχύννω.

ἔλαιον.s: ἔλαιον (oleum), olive-oil: ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως, oil of enjoyment, the oil with which the heads of guests at banquets are anointed, Heb. i 9.

ἐλευθερία.s: ἐλευθερία, freedom, liberty, especially a state of freedom from slavery.

ἐνδείκνυμαι.s: ἐνδείκνυμι (in the middle voice ἐνδείκνυμαι only), I show forth.

ἐπισκέπτομαι.g: I visit, have a care for
ἐπισκέπτομαι.s: ἐπισκέπτομαι, (a) I look out, Ac. vi 3; (b) I visit.

ζηλόω.s: ζηλόω, (a) intr. I am jealous; (b) tr. I am jealous of, with acc. of a person; I am eager for, I am eager to possess, with acc. of a thing.

ζωοποιέω.s: ζωοποιέω, I make that which was dead to live.

κακία.s: κακία, (a) evil (i. e. trouble, labour, misfortune), Mt. vi 34; (b) wickedness, Ac. viii 22; (c) vicious disposition, malice, spite.

καταβολή.s: καταβολή, (a) foundation, only in Mt. xiii 35 without κόσμου (add. v. l.); (b) depositing, sowing, deposit, σπέρματος, technically used of the act of conception, Heb. xi 11.

κατάκειμαι.g: I lie down, lie sick, recline (at meals)
κατάκειμαι.s: κατάκειμαι, I recline (at table); more often, I keep my bed, I am lying ill (in bed).

κατασκευάζω.s: κατασκευάζω, I build, construct, prepare, make.

κάτω.s: κάτω, (a) down, below, also downwards; (b) compar. κατωτέρω, lower, under, less, of a length of a time, Mt. ii 16.

καύχημα.s: καύχημα, a boasting, a ground of boasting (glorying, exultation).

κέρας.s: κέρας, (a) a horn; (b) as a symbol of strength, κέρας σωτηρίας, a powerful support of salvation, Lk. i 69; (c) a dwarfed column set upon or at the corner of an altar, with ritual significance, Rev. ix 13.

κλάδος.s: κλάδος, a branch of a tree.

κλῆρος.g: a lot (that which is cast or drawn); a portion
κλῆρος.s: κλῆρος, (a) a lot; (b) a portion assigned, Ac. i 17, viii 21, xxvi 18, Col. i 12; hence, a portion of the people of God assigned to one’s care, a congregation, 1 Pet. v 3.

κλῆσις.s: κλῆσις, a calling, invitation, summons of God to the religious life; sometimes, e.g. Phil. iii 14, 2 Thess. i 11, Heb. iii 1, it may include a reference to the final issue of this invitation.

κλητός.s: κλητός, called, invited, summoned by God to the religious life.

κράβαττος.g: a bed, mattress, mat (of a poor man)
κράβαττος.s: κράβαττος (grabattus), a bed, mattress, mat of a poor man. (Spelling κράβακτος in Egyptian documents.)

λίμνη.d: limnology, the scientific study of ponds and lakes

μεταβαίνω.s: μεταβαίνω, I change my place (abode), I leave, I depart, I remove.

νόσος.d: nosophobia, a morbid fear of disease

ὁμοθυμαδόν.s: ὁμοθυμαδόν, with one mind, with one accord.

παράγω.s: παράγω, (a) I pass by, Mt. xx 30, Mk. xv 21, &c.; (b) I vanish, disappear, 1 Cor. vii 31, in which sense the passive is used, 1 John ii 8, 17 (the verb being originally transitive); (c) I depart, Mt. ix 9, 27 (the text is doubtful in both passages, and therefore this meaning is questionable); (d) almost. I walk, Mk. i 16, ii 14, xv 21 (?)

παραλυτικός.s: παραλυτικός, a paralytic, a more colloquial word than παραλελυμένος, the medical term (cf. Lk. v 24).

παρεμβολή.s: παρεμβολή (castra), a camp, either a fixed camp (statiua castra), occupied possibly for centuries, a fort, castle, like that at Jerusalem, or a marching-camp, according to context; hence, the army occupying such, Heb. xi 34.

περισσοτέρως.s: περισσοτέρως, more exceedingly, to a greater degree: see περισσός.

πηγή.s: πηγή, a spring, a fountain: a well, John iv 6.

πληθύνω.s: πληθύνω, (a) tr. I multiply, I increase; (b) intr. I multiply, I go on increasing, Ac. vi 1.

ποιμαίνω.s: ποιμαίνω, I shepherd, I tend, I herd: hence I rule.

πρᾶγμα.mg: a deed, thing, difficulty; pl., affairs
πρᾶγμα.s: πρᾶγμα, (a) a deed, action; (b) used more vaguely, a matter, an affair; πρᾶγμα ἔχειν πρός τινα, to have something against one, to have ground for a lawsuit against one (where πρᾶγμα = causa), 1 Cor. vi 1: ἐν τῷ πράγματι, in the matter in hand (i.e. sins of the flesh), rather than generically, in business, 1 Thess. iv 6.

πρότερος.s: πρότερος (becoming replaced by πρῶτος), first of two, former, previous, earlier: acc. as adv. (τὸ) πρότερον, on the former of two occasions, e.g. Gal. iv 13; on a previous occasion; at first, formerly, previously, sometimes used practically as an adj., as the latter was dying out (see πρῶτος), 1 Tim. i 13.

σάλπιγξ.s: σάλπιγξ, a bugle, a war trumpet, used for signals and commands; hence in eschatological passage as signal for Judgement or Resurrection.

σπλάγχνα.s: σπλάγχνον (by-form σπλάγχνα [fem.] in Phil. ii 1, if text be genuine), usually plur. σπλάγχνα, the nobler viscera, heart, &c., and especially, Hebraistically, as the seat of certain feelings, or from the observed effect of emotion on them, compassion and pity.

σπουδάζω.mg: to make haste, be busy, be enthusiastic
σπουδάζω.s: σπουδάζω, I hasten; I am eager (zealous).

σχίζω.s: σχίζω, I cleave, split; (of cloth) I rend, tear: of a crowd, I divide (sharply) into two parties.

τελευτάω.mg: to finish, bring to an end, die

ὕστερον.d: in rhetoric, hysteron-proteron, a reversing of the natural order of the sense, as ‘he is well and lives’

φωτίζω.s: φωτίζω (of the public disclosure of what has been kept secret), I shed light upon, I enlighten; passive with acc. Eph. i 18: I bring to light, Eph. iii 9: in Heb. vi 4, x 32 φωτισθέντες, having received enlightenment, having had experience of God’s grace in conversion.

χιτών.s: χιτών (a Semitic word), a tunic, an undergarment.

χράομαι.d: catachresis, misuse of a word; in rhetoric, a mixed metaphor
χράομαι.s: χράομαι (from χρή ‘necessity’, properly, ‘I make for myself what is necessary with something’) (utor), I use, employ; in 1 Cor. vii 21 perhaps understand τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ: with persons, I treat, Ac. xxvii 3.

ἁγιασμός.s: ἁγιασμός, the process of making or becoming ἅγιος (set apart, holy).

ᾅδης.s: ᾅδης (in LXX=Sheol), Hades, the unseen world, into which the spirits of all persons pass at death.

ἀδύνατος.s: ἀδύνατος, (a) of persons, incapable (Ac. xiv 8, Rom. xv 1); (b) of things, impossible; τὸ ἀδύνατον, either the inability, or that which is impossible (Rom. viii 3).

ἅμα.g: at the same time; with the dat., together with
ἅμα.mg: at the same time with; prep. w. dat., with
ἅμα.s: ἅμα, (a) adv. at the same time, therewith; (b) prep. along with, together with.

ἀνατολή.s: ἀνατολή, (a) rising of the sun; hence, (b) (sing. and plur.) the quarter whence the sun rises, the East.

ἀναφέρω.s: ἀναφέρω, (a) I carry up, lead up; (b) I offer up (on a high altar) as a sacrifice, I offer up to God on high.

ἄνομος.s: ἄνομος, lawless, disobedient to the law of God, sinful; illegal: ἄνομος θεοῦ=ἄνευ νόμου θεοῦ, 1 Cor. ix 21.

ἀπολογέομαι.s: ἀπολογέομαι, I give a defence, I defend myself (especially in a law court): it can take an obj. of what is said in defence.

ἀπολύτρωσις.s: ἀπολύτρωσις, ransoming, deliverance, liberation (from captivity), ransoming away, emancipation, manumission (of a slave by his master) (the idea of payment, though originally present, seems wholly to have disappeared in N.T.).

ἀσπασμός.s: ἀσπασμός (very rare in papyri), a greeting, salutation.

ἀφαιρέω.d: aphaeresis, dropping of a letter or syllable from the beginning of a word, as ‘lone’ from ‘alone’
ἀφαιρέω.mg: to take from or away, deprive of

ἀφορίζω.s: ἀφορίζω, I rail off, I separate, I place apart.

βίβλος.s: βίβλος (liber), a papyrus roll, with a sacred connotation: ζωῆς, see βιβλίον, which had almost ousted it.

βίος.s: βίος (uictus), (a) life; (b) manner of life; livelihood.

δεσπότης.s: δεσπότης, a master, particularly a master and owner of slaves, lord.

διατρίβω.d: diatribe, a prolonged and acrimonious harangue
διατρίβω.s: διατρίβω, I tarry, continue, stay in a place.

δικαίωμα.s: δικαίωμα, (an argument, a pièce justificative, hence) a thing pronounced (by God) to be δίκαιος (just, the right); or the restoration of a criminal, a fresh chance given him; a righteous deed (e.g. Rom. v 18).

ἐκπίπτω.mg: to fall from, lose, be banished
ἐκπίπτω.s: ἐκπίπτω, I fall out, I fall off, I fall away: hence, in nautical language, I fall off from the straight course: of flowers, I fade away, wither away.

ἐμφανίζω.s: ἐμφανίζω, I make visible (manifest); hence, act. I report (inform) against, Ac. xxiv 1, xxv 2, 15; pass. (quasi-technical) I appear before.

ἔνατος.d: Ennead, one division of the collection made by Porphyry of the teachings of Plotinus, arranged in six divisions of nine books each

ἔνοχος.s: ἔνοχος (obnoxius), involved in, hence liable, generally with dat. (or gen.) of the punishment.

ἐξομολογέομαι.d: in the ancient Church, exomologesis, the public confession of sin, usually accompanied by fasting, weeping, and mourning
ἐξομολογέομαι.s: ἐξομολογέω, (a) I consent fully, agree out and out, Lk. xxii 6; (b) I confess, admit, acknowledge (cf. the early Hellenistic sense of the middle, I acknowledge a debt); (c) in certain passages there is a difficulty as to the sense: in Mt. xi 25 (Lk. x 21) the Vulgate (with the Sahidic) renders by confiteor, but modern scholars prefer either I give thanks or I praise.

ἐπιδίδωμι.s: ἐπιδίδωμι, (a) tr. I hand in; (b) intr. I give way (to the wind), Ac. xxvii 15.

θλίβω.s: θλίβω, (a) I make narrow (strictly by pressure), Mt. vii 14; I press upon, Mk. iii 9; (b) I persecute, press hard.

κοινωνός.d: cf. cenobite, one dwelling in a convent community

κοσμέω.s: κοσμέω, I put into order; I decorate, deck, adorn.

μακράν.s: μακράν (procul), adv. sometimes used adjectivally, at a distance, far away.

μακροθυμέω.s: μακροθυμέω, I defer my anger, I am long-suffering, i.e. the opposite of short- or quick-tempered.

μέλει.s: μέλει, impersonal, it is a care, it is an object of anxiety, c. dat. of the person: personal, διὸ μελήσω, wherefore I will take care, true text in 2 Pet. i 12 (Field).

νομικός.g: pertaining to the law; as a noun, one skilled in the Mosaic law, a lawyer
νομικός.s: νομικός, (a) adj. connected with law, about law, Tit. iii 9; (b) noun a lawyer, one learned in the Law (i.e. in the Gospels), one learned in the Old Testament scriptures (like γραμματεύς), a scribe; a jurist, Tit. iii 13.

ξενίζω.g: I entertain (a stranger); I startle, bewilder
ξενίζω.s: ξενίζω, (a) I entertain a stranger; (b) I startle, bewilder, Ac. xvii 20, 1 Pet. iv 4, 12.

ὅδε.mg: this; often he, she, it. Latin hic
ὅδε.s: ὅδε (hic), this here, this; also as pronoun.

οἰκονόμος.s: οἰκονόμος (dispensator), (a) a steward (commonly a superior slave of tried character, who looked after the accounts of a household; hence met. 1 Cor. iv 1, 2, Tit. i 7, 1 Pet. iv 10; (b) apparently, City Steward or Treasurer, Rom. xvi 23; (c) perhaps not to be separated from (a), (curator) a guardian, a legal guardian, Gal. iv 2. In any case he manages the property of the ‘infant’ till the age of 25, perhaps.

ὀνομάζω.d: cf. onomasticon, a collection of proper names
ὀνομάζω.s: ὀνομάζω, I name, give a name to.

παντοκράτωρ.g: a ruler of all, the Almighty
παντοκράτωρ.s: παντοκράτωρ, ruler of all, ruler of the universe; the LXX introduced κύριος (θεὸς) παντοκράτωρ as a translation of Lord of Hosts.

πατάσσω.s: πατάσσω, I strike (as, with a sword).

πλάνη.d: cf. planet, which to the ancients was apparently a wandering celestial body
πλάνη.s: πλάνη, wandering from the way, and so metaphorically, error (perhaps sometimes actively, deceit).

πλατεῖα.s: πλατεῖα (sc. ὁδός), a public square (as in modern Greek, Lat. platea, cf. Fr. place, Germ. Platz, Span. plaza, Ital. piazza); generally taken as an open street, a street.

πλεονεξία.s: πλεονεξία, covetousness, greediness, rapacity, entire disregard of the rights of others, a word active in meaning and wide in scope.

ποικίλος.s: ποικίλος (uarius), manycoloured, particoloured; hence varied, various (plurality as well as difference seems sometimes to be suggested).

πόρνος.s: πόρνος, a male prostitute: the weaker sense, one who consorts with πόρναι, a fornicator, is generally adopted for N.T.

προέρχομαι.s: προέρχομαι, (a) intr. I go in front (before): sometimes with acc. of distance covered, Ac. xii 10; (b) tr. I precede, Mk. vi 33, Lk. xxii 47.

προσκαρτερέω.s: προσκαρτερέω, (a) I continue all the time, I continue stedfast, I persist, either of remaining in a place, or of persisting in a certain course of action; (b) I attach myself assiduously to, Ac. viii 13, x 7; (c) with a lifeless subject, I continue near (at hand), Mk. iii 9.

σέβομαι.s: σέβομαι, I reverence, worship: generally in Ac. of godfearing, uncircumcised Gentiles who joined the Jewish synagogues (contrast Ac. xiii 43).

σιωπάω.d: aposiopesis, in rhetoric, a figure of speech in which the speaker breaks off suddenly
σιωπάω.s: σιωπάω, I keep silence, I am silent.

στρατηγός.s: στρατηγός (praetor), (a) in Jerusalem, ὁ στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ, the commandant of the temple, a priest, next in rank to the high-priest, and commander of the priests and Levites who guarded the temple, Ac. iv 1, v 24, 26: under him were the στρατηγοί, captains of the temple-guards, Lk. xxii [4,] 52; (b) at Philippi, a Roman ‘colonia’, a praetor or a duumvir, a chief-magistrate of the ‘colonia’, Ac. xvi (there were probably two of them).

συγγενής.g: kindred; as a noun, a relative, kinsman
συγγενής.s: συγγενής, a relation, relative, kinsman: in Rom. ix 3 the term is wide enough to include all Hebrews: in Rom. xvi 7, 11, 21 the reference may be narrower, to fellow-members of the same (Jewish) tribe (φυλή) in the city of Tarsus.

σύνδουλος.s: σύνδουλος, a fellow-slave, either of an earthly master, or of the glorified Lord.

συνζητέω.s: συνζητέω (lit. I seek in company), I discuss, debate, dispute.

τάσσω.s: τάσσω, (a) I put in its place, assign, fix, Mt. viii 9 (v.l.), Lk. vii 8, Ac. xiii 48, xxii 10, Rom. xiii 1, 1 Cor. xvi 15; (b) I order, c. acc. et inf. Ac. xv 2: mid. I order by virtue of my power (authority), Mt. xxviii 16; with plural subject, we fix upon among ourselves, Ac. xxviii 23.

ταχέως.s: ταχέως, quickly, swiftly, speedily: compar. form τάχειον (with superl. force in all places except John xx 4): superl. ὡς τάχιστα, as quickly as possible.

τέταρτος.d: cf. tetrarch, a ruler over a fourth part

φείδομαι.s: φείδομαι, I spare, I exempt from punishment or injury (death).

χωρίον.d: cf. chorography, describing, or description, of districts
χωρίον.s: χωρίον (diminutive of χώρα or χῶρος), a place; a piece of land, a field, enclosed.

ψεῦδος.s: ψεῦδος, that which is false, falsehood; an untruth, a lie; lying: in Rom. i 25 abstract for concrete.

περιάγω.s: περιάγω, (a) tr. (1) I carry about, (2) I go about; (b) intr. I go about.

ἀρχισυνάγωγος.s: ἀρχισυνάγωγος, a leader of the synagogue, a leading man (or woman) connected with the synagogue: sometimes there was only one, and the name was in some cases merely honorary.

ἐπισυνάγω.g: I collect, gather together at one place

ἀξιόω.mg: to deem worthy, honor, demand, suppose
ἀξιόω.s: ἀξιόω, I account or treat as worthy.

ἀξίως.s: ἀξίως, worthily; in a manner worthy of....

ἀγών.s: ἀγών, an (athletic) contest; hence, a struggle (in the soul).

ἁγνός.g: (in a condition prepared for worship), pure (ethically, ritually, or ceremonially), chaste
ἁγνός.s: ἁγνός (originally, in a condition prepared for worship), pure (either ethically, or ritually, ceremonially); chaste.

ἁγνίζω.s: ἁγνίζω, I make pure, either (a) ceremonially (e.g. Ac. xxi 24), or (b) actually (e.g. 1 Pet. i 22).

παραγγελία.s: παραγγελία, a command, an injunction; a precept, rule of living, 1 Thess. iv 2.

ἀλλάσσω.g: (I make other than it is), I change, alter

καταλλάσσω.g: I change (from enmity to friendship), reconcile

ἀρετή.s: ἀρετή (uirtus, a word of wide significance in non-Christian ethics), excellence, particularly moral excellence; manifestation of power, 2 Pet. i 3.

ἀπαρχή.s: ἀπαρχή, first-fruits, the earliest crop of the year; hence also metaph., for example, of the earliest converts in a district. There is evidence in favour of rendering in some passages merely by sacrifice, gift.

ἐπιβαίνω.g: I go up to, mount, board (a boat)
ἐπιβαίνω.s: ἐπιβαίνω, (a) I set foot on, I step on; (b) I mount (a horse), board (a vessel).

παράβασις.g: (a going over [the line]), transgression, a transgression

παραβάτης.s: παραβάτης (lit. an overstepper), a transgressor, a lawbreaker.

προβαίνω.mg: to advance, proceed, take the lead
προβαίνω.s: προβαίνω, I go forward, move forward, advance: met. I advance (in years), Lk. i 7, 18, ii 36.

συμβαίνω.s: συμβαίνω, with neut. subject or impersonally, I happen, occur: it happens.

βέβαιος.g: (reduplicated stem, βε-βα-, standing fast), solid, sure, firm

βέβηλος.s: βέβηλος, profane, secular; unspiritual, godless, worldly, Heb. xii 16.

λιθοβολέω.g: I pelt with stones, kill by stoning
λιθοβολέω.s: λιθοβολέω, I stone, I cast stones (at).

συμβάλλω.g: (I throw together), I encounter, meet, consider; middle, contribute to
συμβάλλω.mg: to unite; sometimes in mid., interpret
συμβάλλω.s: συνβάλλω, (a) with λόγους expressed or understood, I engage in discussion with, Lk. xi 53 (v.l.), Ac. iv 15, xvii 18; (b) I reflect, ponder, Lk. ii 19; (c) I meet with, I fall in with, Ac. xx 14; in hostile sense, I enter into conflict with, attack, Lk. xiv 31; (d) mid. I contribute to, benefit.

ὑπερβάλλω.g: (I surpass in throwing), I surpass, exceed
ὑπερβάλλω.s: ὑπερβάλλω, intr. I exceed, surpass, c. gen.: pcpl. present, absolutely, excessive, extraordinary.

ὑπερβολή.s: ὑπερβολή, excess, abundance; καθ᾽ ὑπερβολήν, superlatively, exceedingly, beyond measure.

βασιλικός.s: βασιλικός, connected with a king, royal, regal; in James ii 8 βασιλικὸς νόμος, a supreme law is referred to, the more important parts of the law: substantivally (a) an officer in the service of the king (Herod Antipas), John iv 46, 49; (b) ἡ βασιλικὴ (sc. χώρα), the king's country, Ac. xii 20.

περιβλέπομαι.s: περιβλέπομαι, I look round on, survey.

γένημα.s: γένημα (from γίνομαι), of vegetable, never of animal, products (contrast γέννημα), fruit, crop, produce of the earth.

ἐπιγινώσκω.s: ἐπιγινώσκω, I come to know by directing my attention to (ἐπί) him or it, I perceive, discern, recognize: aor. I found out.

προγινώσκω.s: προγινώσκω (properly, I get to know (I learn) beforehand), (a) I know previously; (b) I designate before (to a position or function), 1 Pet. i 20.

δείκνυμι and δεικνύω.s: δείκνυμι, δεικνύω, I point out, show.

ἐπιδείκνυμι.s: ἐπιδείκνυμι, I show, display, point out, indicate; I prove, demonstrate, Ac. xviii 28, Heb. vi 17.

ὑποδείκνυμι.g: (I show by placing under [the eyes]), I warn
ὑποδείκνυμι.s: ὑποδείκνυμι, I point out, show; hence I advise, warn, Mt. iii 7, Lk. iii 7.

ὑπόδειγμα.s: ὑπόδειγμα, (a) a sign, image of something, Heb. viii 5, ix 23; (b) an example, given for imitation.

ἀποδέχομαι.s: ἀποδέχομαι, I receive, welcome, entertain (with hospitality); hence metaph. Ac. ii 41, xxiv 3.

ἀπεκδέχομαι.s: ἀπεκδέχομαι (rare), I expect eagerly, I wait for eagerly.

ἐκδικέω.s: ἐκδικέω, I give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate.

ἀντίδικος.g: an opponent in a suit at law, an adversary
ἀντίδικος.s: ἀντίδικος (aduersarius), an opponent (in a lawsuit): probably so even in 1 Pet. v 8.

ἐκδίκησις.s: ἐκδίκησις, (a) defence, avenging, vindication, vengeance; (b) full (complete) punishment, 2 Thess. i 8, 1 Pet. ii 14.

μεταδίδωμι.s: μεταδίδωμι (lit. I offer by way of change, I offer so that a change of owner is produced), I share; sometimes merely, I impart.

δωρεάν.g: (accusative of the noun, used adverbially: as a gift, gift-wise), freely
δωρεάν.s: δωρεάν (acc. of δωρεά used as adv., cf. gratis abl. plur. of gratia), as a free gift, without payment, freely, gratis.

εὐδοκία.s: εὐδοκία, (a) good-will (good-pleasure), favour, feeling of complacency of God to man: ἄνθρωποι εὐδοκίας (Hebraistic), men with whom God is well-pleased, Lk. ii 14; (b) good-pleasure, satisfaction, happiness, delight of men, e. g. 2 Thess. i 11, though even in such passages there may be a latent reference to (divine) approval.

συνευδοκέω.g: I entirely approve of, agree with

ἀποδοκιμάζω.s: ἀποδοκιμάζω, I reject after testing (examination), I disqualify.

ἀδόκιμος.g: (failing to pass the test), unapproved, counterfeit
ἀδόκιμος.s: ἀδόκιμος, failing to pass the test, unapproved, counterfeit.

ἐνδυναμόω.g: I endue with power, make strong
ἐνδυναμόω.s: ἐνδυναμόω, I fill with δύναμις (power) (almost = δυναμόω).

δύνατος.s: δυνατός, (a) of persons, powerful, able; (b) of things, possible.

ἐπέρχομαι.s: ἐπέρχομαι, I come upon, sometimes with hostility.

ἄπειμι.s: ἄπειμι (B), I shall go away, I go away (only Ac. xvii 10).

ἐπέχω.g: I hold out, give attention to
ἐπέχω.s: ἐπέχω, (a) tr. I hold forth; (b) intr. (νοῦν being understood) I mark, pay attention (heed), note, Ac. iii 5, 1 Tim. iv 16: I delay, Ac. xix 22.

μετέχω.g: I have a share in, partake of
μετέχω.s: μετέχω, I have a share of, I participate in, I share.

μέτοχος.g: sharing in; as a noun, a partner
μέτοχος.s: μέτοχος, a sharer, partner; c. gen. in something.

ὑπερέχω.g: (I hold over, above), I rise above, am superior
ὑπερέχω.s: ὑπερέχω, absol. or c. gen. or c. acc. I am superior, I am supreme; I surpass.

εὐσχήμων.g: of elegant figure (way of holding oneself), graceful, of good standing
εὐσχήμων.s: εὐσχήμων, (a) comely, seemly, decorous; (b) of honourable position (in society).

μετασχηματίζω.g: I change the figure of, transfigure
μετασχηματίζω.s: μετασχηματίζω, I change the outward appearance (the dress, the form of presentment) of something; I transfer by a fiction, adapt.

παρρησιάζομαι.s: παρρησιάζομαι, I speak boldly, I am bold of speech.

συνεργέω.g: I work along with, co-operate with
συνεργέω.s: συνεργέω, I work along with, I co-operate with.

ἐργασία.s: ἐργασία, working, activity, work, service, trade, business, gains of business: δὸς ἐργασίαν (da operam), take pains to, see to it that you, Lk. xii 58; performance, practice, Eph. iv 19.

λειτουργός.s: λειτουργός, minister, servant, of an official character; of priests and levites, Heb. viii 2.

πανουργία.g: (ability to do anything, cleverness), craftiness, cunning
πανουργία.s: πανουργία, (a) cleverness, usually with the idea that it is evil; (b) cunning, craftiness, Lk. xx 23.

ἀργός.s: ἀργός, (a) idle, lazy; (b) thoughtless, Mt. xii 36.

εἶδος.s: εἶδος, visible form, shape, appearance, outward show; in 1 Thess. v 22 = kind, species, class.

εἰδωλολάτρης.s: εἰδωλολάτρης, a server (worshipper) of an image (of a god).

ζήτημα.s: ζήτημα (quaestio), a question, subject of inquiry.

θνήσκω.g: I die; perfect tense, I am dead
θνήσκω.mg: to die, perish; 2 pf. τέθνηκα, be dead
θνήσκω.s: θνῄσκω, I am dying: perf. τέθνηκα, I am dead; τεθνηκώς, dead.

ἀποτίθεμαι.g: I put off from myself, lay aside
ἀποτίθεμαι.s: ἀποτίθεμαι, I put off (away), cast off (away) from myself; hence, I put, store (in).

διατίθημι.s: διατίθεμαι, (a) I appoint, make (of a covenant); (b) I make (a will) (regular in papyri), Heb. ix 16, 17.

μετατίθημι.s: μετατίθημι, (a) I transfer, Ac. vii 16, Heb. xi 5; mid. I go over to another party, I desert, Gal. i 6; (b) I change, Heb. vii 12.

περιτίθημι.s: περιτίθημι, I place around; I put about (upon), I clothe with.

θεμελιόω.g: I lay the foundation of, make stable
θεμελιόω.s: θεμελιόω, I found, lit. and met.

θησαυρίζω.s: θησαυρίζω, I store up, I treasure up, I save.

ἀποθήκη.g: a place in which anything is laid by, a storehouse, granary, barn
ἀποθήκη.s: ἀποθήκη, a store-house, store-room for food-stuffs, a barn.

ἀνάθεμα.g: (a thing laid by or set up; a thing devoted to the vengeance of God), a curse, a man accursed
ἀνάθεμα.s: ἀνάθεμα (properly, a devoting to the vengeance of the infernal goddesses), a curse, a cursed thing. Distinguish from ἀνάθημα, q.v.

ἄνεσις.s: ἄνεσις (opposite of θλῖψις, lit. loosening, relaxing), (a) relief, remission, indulgence, freedom, Ac. xxiv 23; (b) rest.

ἀσύνετος.s: ἀσύνετος (insipiens, non intellegens, Ambros. expos. in ps. cxviii 20 55 § 2), unintelligent, without wisdom, unwise, undiscerning (implying probably moral defect, like ἀμαθής sometimes in classical Greek).

ἰσχύω.s: ἰσχύω, I have strength, I am strong, I am in full health and vigour (opp. κακῶς ἔχω) Mt. ix 12; and so I am able, sometimes followed by the inf. or εἰς c. acc. to indicate the purpose for which the strength is used, e. g. Mt. xxvi 40, v 13; c. acc. adverbially, qualifying the strength, τι ἰσχύει, has any validity (value), Gal. v 6, cf. Heb. ix 17, πάντα ἰσχύω, I have all strength (power), Phil. iv 13, πολὺ ἰσχύει, has great power, James v 16.

καθαρισμός.s: καθαρισμός, cleansing, purifying, purification, literal, ceremonial, or moral.

καλέω.s: καλέω, (a) I call, summon, invite; (b) I call, name: ἐπί, after, Lk. i 59.

ἐγκαλέω.s: ἐγκαλέω, I bring a charge against.

ἀνέγκλητος.g: not to be called to account, unreprovable, blameless
ἀνέγκλητος.s: ἀνέγκλητος, irreproachable (especially in private life), blameless.

ἐπικαλέομαι.g: I call, name; middle, I invoke, appeal to
ἐπικαλέομαι.s: ἐπικαλέω, (a) I call (name) by a supplementary (additional, alternative) name; (b) mid. I call upon, appeal to, address.

παράκλητος.s: παράκλητος (aduocatus), (originally passive in sense, one called in for support, one summoned as support, but this idea drops into the background: in the technical legal sense it never occurs, but in writings prior to the N.T. has the general sense, one who speaks in favour of another, an intercessor, helper: it tends thus to have an active sense, and was borrowed by Hebrew and Aramaic) helper; consoler (corresponding to the name Menahem given to the Messiah).

συνκαλέω.s: συνκαλέω, I call together, invite, summon; mid. I call together to myself.

ἀντίκειμαι.s: ἀντίκειμαι (used as a passive for ἀντιτίθημι, just as κεῖμαι is a passive for τίθημι), I resist, oppose.

ἐπίκειμαι.g: I lie upon, press upon, am urgent
ἐπίκειμαι.s: ἐπίκειμαι, (a) c. dat. or c. ἐπί et dat. I am placed upon, am laid upon, lie upon, am imposed; I press upon, Lk. v 1; (b) absol. I press hard, Ac. xxvii 20; I am insistent, insist, Lk. xxiii 23.

περίκειμαι.g: I am compassed about with, have around me
περίκειμαι.s: περίκειμαι, I am placed around something; I have had something placed around me, Ac. xxviii 20, Heb. v 2.

πρόκειμαι.g: I am set before, am present
πρόκειμαι.s: πρόκειμαι, I am set (placed, put) before, I am already there.

συνανάκειμαι.s: συνανάκειμαι, I recline at (dinner-) table with.

κοινωνέω.g: I have a share of, take part in
κοινωνέω.s: κοινωνέω, (a) I share, communicate, contribute, impart, Rom. xii 13, Gal. vi 6; (b) I share in, I have a share of, I have fellowship with, c. gen. or dat.

κόπτω.g: I cut; middle, I strike (my breast or head in lamentation
κόπτω.mg: to knock down, strike, cut, knock at
κόπτω.s: κόπτω, (a) I cut, I cut off, Mt. xxi 8, Mk. xi 8; (b) mid. (plango) I beat my breast or head in lamentation, I lament, mourn, sometimes with acc. (ἐπὶ c. acc.) of person whose loss is mourned.

ἀποκόπτω.s: ἀποκόπτω, (a) I cut off, I cut loose; (b) I emasculate, castrate (Gal. v 12, where middle = passive, probably).

ἐνκόπτω.s: ἐνκόπτω, (I introduce an obstacle sharply in the way of a moving object, cf. Eng. colloquial ‘I strike in’) I block, check, hinder.

προσκόπτω.g: I strike against, stumble, stumble at
προσκόπτω.s: προσκόπτω (offendo), I strike against; intr., Mt. vii 27, &c., also absol. I stumble, John xi 9, 10, Rom. xiv 21; I stumble at, 1 Pet. ii 8. Sometimes met. (cf. πρόσκομμα).

πρόσκομμα.g: a stumbling, a stumbling block, an obstacle

ὑπόκρισις.s: ὑπόκρισις (acting a part, properly), hypocrisy, pose.

ἐπιλαμβάνω.s: ἐπιλαμβάνομαι, I lay hold of, take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).

μεταλαμβάνω.g: I have a share of, partake of, get
μεταλαμβάνω.s: μεταλαμβάνω, (a) c. gen. I take a share (part) of, I share in, I partake of; (b) c. acc. I take after (later) or I take instead, Ac. xxiv 25.

ὑπολαμβάνω.g: I take up (by supporting beneath); I welcome; I catch up (in speech); I suppose
ὑπολαμβάνω.s: ὑπολαμβάνω, (a) (subueho) I receive from beneath, I take up, Ac. i 9; (b) I welcome, entertain, 3 John 8; (c) I catch up in speech, by answering or contradicting or supplementing, Lk. x 30; (d) I suppose, imagine.

λανθάνω.g: I am hidden from, escape notice (2nd aor., ἔ-λαθ-ον)
λανθάνω.mg: to escape notice, lie hid; mid. and pass., forget
λανθάνω.s: λανθάνω, I am hidden (concealed), I lie hid, I escape notice, sometimes with acc. of person from whom concealment takes place, Ac. xxvi 26, 2 Pet. iii 8: with participles (classical constr.), I do so and so unconsciously, unknown to myself, I shut my eyes to so and so, Heb. xiii 2.

ἐκλογή.g: a choosing out, election (in the New Testament always of the divine choice)
ἐκλογή.s: ἐκλογή, choosing out, selecting, choice (by God): in Ac. ix 15 a Hebraistic genitive, equivalent to ἐκλεκτόν.

εὐλογητός.s: εὐλογητός (used only of God), blessed (as entitled to receive blessing from man).

ἀπολογία.g: a defense (especially in a law court)
ἀπολογία.s: ἀπολογία, a defence (particularly in a law court).

ἐκλύομαι.g: I am unstrung, grow weary, become faint-hearted
ἐκλύομαι.s: ἐκλύομαι, I am unstrung, become weak, fail.

παραλύομαι.g: (I am unstrung), I am a paralytic

προσμένω.s: προσμένω, I remain: c. dat., I abide in, I remain in, I persist in.

ἀναμιμνήσκομαι.s: ἀναμιμνῄσκω, (a) act. I remind; (b) mid. or pass. I am reminded, remind myself, remember, recall.

ὑπομιμνήσκω.s: ὑπομιμνήσκω, I remind: pass. practically I remember, Lk. xxii 61.

μνεία.s: μνεία, remembrance, recollection, mention; commemoration, Rom. xii 13 (v.l.).

μνῆμα.g: (something that brings to remembrance), a sepulcher, tomb, monument

διαμαρτυρέομαι.s: διαμαρτύρομαι, I give solemn evidence, I testify (declare) solemnly.

νουθετέω.g: (I put in mind), I admonish, warn, exhort

ἐποικοδομέω.s: ἐποικοδομέω, I build upon (above) a foundation.

οἰκέω.s: οἰκέω, I dwell, lit. and met.; c. acc. I inhabit.

ἐνοικέω.s: ἐνοικέω, I dwell in, am settled (stationary) in.

οἰκονομία.s: οἰκονομία, household management, stewardship, the office of a steward; hence met. of any position of trust or the duties of that position, provision, arrangement, dispensation (even God being sometimes regarded as steward).

ὁμοίωμα.s: ὁμοίωμα (originally, a thing made like something else), likeness, or rather form. (In fact ὁμοίωμα (concrete) differs from ὁμοιότης (abstract) much as simulacrum differs from similitudo.)

ὁμολογία.s: ὁμολογία, a confession (the act rather than the contents or substance) of faith in Christ: 1 Tim. vi 12 refers either to that at baptism or to that at ordination: 1 Tim. vi 13 is referred by Pelagius to John xviii 37, not inappropriately.

ὄψομαι.s: ὁράω, I see; hence, like γεύω, widened in sense to mean, I experience (Lk. iii 6, &c.): ὅρα (ὅρατε) μή, (uide, uidete ne), see that you do not..., beware of doing so and so; beware lest.

ἀνθρώπινος.s: ἀνθρώπινος, belonging to human beings (especially as contrasted with God), human (as contrasted with divine): perhaps moderate, Rom. vi 19, 1 Cor. x 13.

πάντως.s: πάντως, entirely; in any case; (after a negative) at all; assuredly, to be sure.

παραπορεύομαι.s: παραπορεύομαι, I go past, Mk. xi 20, xv 29 (= Mt. xxvii 39): I go, apparently a colloquial or incorrect use, Mk. ii 23 (v. l.), ix 30 (v. l.).

ἔμπορος.g: (one on a journey, especially for business), a merchant

ἀπορέω.g: (I lose the way), I am in doubt, perplexed
ἀπορέω.mg: to be in doubt, be puzzled
ἀπορέω.s: ἀπορέω (lit. I lose the way), esp. in mid., I am in difficulties, I am at my wits' end.

πορνεύω.g: I commit fornication; metaphorically of idolatry (in accord with Biblical imagery. the marriage relationship between God and his people is broken by the worship of idols)
πορνεύω.s: πορνεύω, I practise fornication, especially of men consorting with πόρναι.

καταπέτασμα.s: καταπέτασμα (lit. that which is spread out downwards, that which hangs down), curtain, of that which separated the Holy of Holies from the outer parts of the temple at Jerusalem, also of an outer curtain at the entrance to the Holy Place in the same temple; the latter is strictly denoted by κάλυμμα; yet Heb. ix 3 speaks of the former as τὸ δεύτερον καταπέτασμα.

ἐμπίπτω.s: ἐμπίπτω, I fall in, am cast in.

προσπίπτω.g: I fall towards, prostrate myself before
προσπίπτω.s: προσπίπτω, I fall upon; I fall at (beside).

πτῶμα.g: (the fallen body of one dead), a corpse

καταπίνω.g: I drink down, devour, swallow up
καταπίνω.s: καταπίνω, (a) (originally of liquids, extended to solids) I drink up, swallow, gulp down; I gobble; (b) pass. lit. and met. I drown, am drowning.

ἀπείθεια.s: ἀπείθεια, disobedience, rebellion, contumacy: for υἱοὶ τῆς ἀπειθείας, see υἱός.

ἀπιστέω.s: ἀπιστέω, (a) I am unfaithful; (b) I disbelieve.

πλήρης.s: πλήρης (sometimes, from about the beginning of our era, indeclinable, and used for any case singular or plural, a usage perhaps derived from commercial life: e.g. Mk. iv 28 (?), John i 14, where πλήρης agrees with δόξαν, and there should be no parenthesis, Ac. vi 5 (v.l.)), full.

ἀναπληρόω.s: ἀναπληρόω, (a) I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, Phil. ii 30; (b) I fulfil, I carry out the commands (provisions, &c.) of, Mt. xiii 14, Gal. vi 2, &c.

πλεονάζω.g: I abound in, make to abound
πλεονάζω.s: πλεονάζω, (a) intr. I abound, I increase; (b) tr. I make to abound, I cause to increase, 1 Thess. iii 12.

πλεονεκτέω.g: (I have more), I gain the advantage of, defraud
πλεονεκτέω.s: πλεονεκτέω, I take advantage of, I overreach, I defraud (sometimes with reference to adultery and the injury thus done to the husband).

διασώζω.s: διασῴζω, I save (rescue) through (some danger): διασ. πρός (Ac. xxiii 34), I bring safely to, so διεσώθησαν εἰς (1 Pet. iii 20), escaped into.

σωφρονέω.s: σωφρονέω, (a) I am in my senses, Mk. v 15 (Lk. viii 35); (b) I am sober-minded, I am orderly and restrained in all the relations of life.

σκηνόω.g: I dwell in a tent, encamp
σκηνόω.s: σκηνόω, I dwell as in a tent, I encamp.

σκιά.s: σκιά, a shadow, darkness, shade: contrasted with the body casting the shadow, and used met. somewhat like a pale reflexion, Col. ii 17, Heb. viii 5, x 1.

σκοτίζομαι.g: I am covered with darkness, darkened

ἐνίστημι.g: I am at hand, am present
ἐνίστημι.s: ἐνίστημι: only in the intr. tenses, I impend, am at hand, am present: perf. pcpl. ἐνεστηκώς (ἐνεστώς) as adj. present.

ἐπιστάτης.g: (one standing over another), a master (found only in Luke, used of Jesus)
ἐπιστάτης.s: ἐπιστάτης, master, teacher (cf. Dalman, Words of Jesus, Eng. tr., p. 276).

ἀποκαθίστημι and ἀποκαθιστάνω.g: I set up again, restore to its former state
ἀποκαθίστημι and ἀποκαθιστάνω.s: ἀποκαθιστάνω, ἀποκαθίστημι, I set up again, I restore to its original position or condition; hence, I restore, give back.

μεθίστημι and μεθιστάνω.s: μεθιστάνω, μεθίστημι, I cause to change its place, I move out of its place, I translate, transfer, remove.

προΐστημι.g: I stand in front, lead, rule, practice
προΐστημι.s: προίστημι: in intr. tenses, I take up a position (stand) in front: I take the lead, I rule; hence, c. gen. I lead, supervise, manage; also I practise, exercise a calling or profession.

συνίστημι and συνιστάνω.g: I commend; I stand with, consist
συνίστημι and συνιστάνω.s: συνίστημι, συνιστάνω, (a) in transitive tenses, (1) I recommend, commend, introduce, Rom. xvi 1, 2 Cor. iii 1, iv 2, v 12, vi 4, x 12, 18, xii 11; (2) I show, prove, Rom. iii 5, v 8, 2 Cor. vii 11, Gal. ii 18; (b) in intransitive tenses, (1) I stand with (by), Lk. ix 32; (2) I consist, I am held together, Col. i 17, 2 Pet. iii 5.

στάσις.s: στάσις, (a) faction, sedition, discord; disturbance, upheaval, revolution, riot; (b) in the more original but much rarer meaning, standing, position, place, Heb. ix 8.

ἔκστασις.s: ἔκστασις (properly, distraction or disturbance of mind caused by a shock), bewilderment.

ὑπόστασις.s: ὑπόστασις (lit. an underlying), (a) confidence, assurance; (b) a giving substance (or reality) to, or a guaranteeing, Heb. xi 1 (where possibly title-deed is the sense); (c) substance, reality, Heb. i 3.

ἀκαταστασία.s: ἀκαταστασία, disturbance, upheaval, revolution, almost anarchy, first in the political, and thence in the moral sphere.

συνσταυρόω.s: συνσταυρόω, I crucify along with, lit. or met.

διαστέλλομαι.s: διαστέλλομαι, I give a commission (instructions), I order.

στολή.g: (a piece of equipment, especially of clothes, apparel), a long robe, a festal robe
στολή.s: στολή, a long robe, worn by the upper classes in the East.

ἀντιτάσσομαι.g: I range in battle against, resist
ἀντιτάσσομαι.s: ἀντιτάσσομαι, I range myself against, resist (the attack of).

ἀποτάσσομαι.g: I separate myself, take leave of, forsake
ἀποτάσσομαι.s: ἀποτάσσομαι, I give parting instructions; I say farewell (good-bye), I take leave.

ἐπιταγή.s: ἐπιταγή, instruction, command, order, authority (often of a god).

τάξις.g: an arrangement, order, right order, office
τάξις.s: τάξις, (a) appointed order, Lk. i 8; regulation, rule, perhaps office, Heb. v 6, &c.; (b) right order, 1 Cor. xiv 40, orderly attitude, Col. ii 5.

συντελέω.s: συντελέω, I bring to an end, complete, finish, exhaust; I accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass.

συντέλεια.s: συντέλεια, with αἰῶνος, a characteristic expression of Jewish apocalyptic, conclusion, consummation, end of the present period of time.

ἀτιμάζω.s: ἀτιμάζω, I disgrace, treat disgracefully, dishonour, insult; I despise.

ἔντιμος.s: ἔντιμος, (held precious, hence) precious; honoured, honourable in rank, &c., Lk. xiv 8.

ὕψος.s: ὕψος, (a) height; (b) heaven, Lk. i 78, xxiv 49, Eph. iv 8; (c) met. spiritual height.

ἐπιφάνεια.g: an appearing, manifestation (of Christ in glory)
ἐπιφάνεια.s: ἐπιφάνεια, appearing, manifestation (of a conspicuous intervention from the sky on behalf of a worshipper).

ἀφανίζω.g: (I make unseen), I destroy; passive, I vanish
ἀφανίζω.mg: to make way with; pass., vanish
ἀφανίζω.s: ἀφανίζω, I cause to disappear, hide, remove; I disfigure (probably by leaving unwashed for a long period), Mt. vi 16.

συμφωνέω.g: I am in accord, agree with
συμφωνέω.s: συμφωνέω, (first of a harmony of voices, then) I harmonize with, I agree with; of more than one, we agree together: pass. impers. it is agreed upon among (possibly a Latinism, conuenit inter), Ac. v 9.

πρόφασις.s: πρόφασις, ostensible reason for which a thing is done (that is, commonly, the false reason), pretence; excuse, pretext: προφάσει, under colour, under pretence.

ἀποφέρω.s: ἀποφέρω, I carry, bear away (sometimes with violence, as Mk. xv 1).

ἐκφέρω.s: ἐκφέρω, I bring out, carry out, sometimes (effero) out of the city for burial; I bring forth, bear, Heb. vi 8.

φορέω.s: φορέω, I carry; hence, very often, I wear.

καρποφορέω.s: καρποφορέω (fructifico), act. and mid. I bear fruit.

πληροφορέω.g: I accomplish, satisfy fully, fully convince
πληροφορέω.s: πληροφορέω (lit. I carry full), (a) I complete, carry out fully, 2 Tim. iv 5, 17, Lk. i 1 (?); (b) I fully convince, Rom. iv 21, xiv 5; perhaps I satisfy fully, Col. iv 12; (c) I fully believe, Lk. i 1 (?).

φορτίον.s: φορτίον, (a) a burden; (b) a cargo, Ac. xxvii 10.

καταφρονέω.s: καταφρονέω, I despise, scorn, and show it by active insult.

φύλλον.s: φύλλον, a leaf of a tree.

χάριν.g: (accusative of the noun χάρις used absolutely, in favor of, for the pleasure of), preposition with the gen., on account of, for the sake of
χάριν.s: χάριν, acc. sing. of χάρις, used as adv., for the sake of, by reason of, on account of.

χρηστός.s: χρηστός, good; hence comfortable, kindly, not pressing, Mt. xi 30: often has the idea of kind (iuxta apostolum χρηστὸν ‘bonum’ intellegimus, quia dixit Vide ergo bonitatem domini [Rom. xi 22]; iuxta euangelium χρηστὸν ‘suaue’ accipimus; dixit enim Tollite iugum meum quia leue est et onus meum quia suaue est [Mt. xi 29, 30]; dixit enim τὸ φορτίον μου χρηστόν. unde merito bonitatem dei ab ipso quaerit doceri, &c. Ambros. expos. in ps. cxviii 9 9 §§ 1, 2).

χρῆμα.g: (whatever one uses, a thing), money; plural, riches
χρῆμα.mg: thing, affair; mostly pl., goods, property, money
χρῆμα.s: χρῆμα, (a) plur. property, possessions, riches; (b) sing. the money got, the proceeds, Ac. iv 37.

χρηματίζω.g: (I transact business, hence, consult, deliberate), I make answer (in an oracle), I warn; passive, I am warned by God; I receive a name (from my business), am called
χρηματίζω.s: χρηματίζω (originally, I transact business), (a) act., of God, I warn, Heb. xii 25; pass. I am warned by God (properly in response to an inquiry as to one’s duty), Mt. ii 12, 22, Lk. ii 26, Ac. x 22, Heb. viii 5, xi 7; (b) (I take a name from my public business, hence) I receive a name, I am publicly called..., Ac. xi 26, Rom. vii 3.

χωρέω.s: χωρέω, (a) intr. I go away, I withdraw, I come, lit. and met., Mt. xv 17, 2 Pet. iii 9; (b) intr. I have room, find room, John viii 37; (c) tr. I contain, am capable of receiving, hold, grasp, Mk. ii 2, Mt. xix 11, &c.; I make room for (I give a place to) some one in my heart, I take into my heart, 2 Cor. vii 2.

ψευδομαρτυρέω.g: I testify falsely, bear false witness
